messages.subject: 如何跑出特徵值
parts:
請問以下是用R跑出共線性診斷的CI值，那R可以估計出共線性診斷的特徵值嗎…
y=c(20,12,10,2,3,8)
x=c(11,2,5,6,1,6)
z=c(7,4,2,3,3,8)
m1=lm(y~x+z)
library(perturb)
colldiag(m1)[1]

messages.author: e9306eecf91f7405
messages.subject: Re: 如何跑出特徵值
parts:
Hi,

mm <- model.matrix(m1)[,-1]

e <- eigen(cor(t(mm) %*% mm))
e

Eigen structure of XX, let  λ1,  λ2, …..,  λp be The eigenvalues of XX (in correlation form).  When at least one eigenvalue is close to zero, then multicollinearity is exist (Greene, (1993), Walker, (1999)).

請參考下面連結的page 2.

http://www.m-hikari.com/ijcms-2011/9-12-2011/rashwanIJCMS9-12-2011.pdf

或另一連結

http://www.scribd.com/doc/52892232/126/Condition-Number-and-Condition-Index

指標間應該會有矛盾的情形發生！
